jobs.description:
We are looking for a Process Assistant Engineer to join our Sweden factory and support the daily management, optimisation and continuous improvement of our separator coating processes.
About Senior Material Europe
At Senior Material Europe, we manufacture separator film – a thin film used in lithium-ion batteries, including batteries for electric vehicles. The separator is a key component that helps make lithium-ion batteries safer, more durable and more efficient, supporting the transition towards a more electrified future.
Our production is modern, advanced and operated under controlled cleanroom conditions. The manufacturing process consists of four main process steps, where precision, stability and quality are essential.
Together, we are building advanced manufacturing capabilities in Europe and developing solutions that make a difference – both today and for the future.
The Role
As a Process Assistant Engineer, you will support the daily operation and continuous improvement of our slurry, coating and slitting processes. You will work with production and process data, assist in troubleshooting and process validation, and contribute to improving process stability, product quality and production efficiency.
The role is hands-on and cross-functional, giving you the opportunity to work closely with Production, Quality, Equipment and R&D teams while developing your technical and analytical skills in a modern manufacturing environment.
Job Responsibilities
Assist in the daily maintenance and optimisation of separator coating processes, including slurry, coating and slitting parameters and other key process conditions.

Provide technical support to Production and assist in troubleshooting issues related to process parameters, materials and other process abnormalities.

Collect, organise and analyse production data and key process parameters, identify abnormal trends and support continuous process improvement.

Assist in process validation and DOE trials, evaluate the impact of parameters on process and product performance, and support optimisation of the process window.

Participate in internal and customer quality investigations using methods such as 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram and FTA.

Assist in developing PDCA actions and verifying their effectiveness.

Support new product trials, new slurry and raw material validation, and process condition verification.

Follow up on trial production and analyse relevant process and quality data.

Work with Equipment Engineers to analyse how different equipment functions affect product quality and support equipment and process improvements.

Assist in preparing and maintaining SOPs, process parameter sheets, work instructions, validation reports, technical reports and other process-related documentation.

Cooperate with Production, Quality, Equipment and R&D teams to resolve production issues, improve process stability and continuously improve product quality.

Your Background
We are looking for someone with:

A bachelor's degree in engineering, chemistry, materials science, manufacturing or another relevant field.

At least 1 year of relevant industrial or manufacturing experience.

A structured and analytical approach to problem-solving.

An interest in process development, production technology and continuous improvement.

Good communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functions.

The ability to analyse data, identify trends and support fact-based technical decisions.

A hands-on approach and the ability to work in a production environment.

Good English communication skills, both spoken and written, in an international working environment.

It Would Be an Advantage If You Have
Experience from coating, slitting, slurry preparation or other continuous manufacturing processes.

Experience with process validation, DOE or statistical process analysis.

Experience with structured problem-solving methods such as 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, FTA or PDCA.

Experience working with production, quality or process data.

Experience from the battery, automotive, chemical, materials or other advanced manufacturing industries.

Familiarity with technical documentation, SOPs and process specifications.

What You Can Expect
You will join an international industrial organisation where process engineering plays an important role in ensuring stable production, high product quality and continuous improvement.
The role offers hands-on experience with advanced manufacturing processes and the opportunity to work closely with Production, Quality, Equipment and R&D teams.
You will have the opportunity to develop your technical and analytical skills while contributing to the optimisation of processes that support the production of separator film for the next generation of lithium-ion batteries.
We value responsibility, collaboration, continuous learning and straightforward communication. Different perspectives are important to us, and we encourage an open and respectful working environment.

jobs.occupation: Finnish radiographers wanted for opportunity in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a qualified radiographer from Finland interested in taking the next step in your career in Sweden?
We are currently recruiting two Finnish radiographers for a smaller, well-functioning radiology department in a coastal community in central Sweden.
This is a long-term opportunity for someone who values modern equipment, close teamwork and a healthy work-life balance. The position offers daytime working hours only, with no evenings, nights, weekends, public holidays or on-call duties.
The department
You will become part of a smaller radiology department with approximately 10 employees, providing both planned and acute diagnostic imaging in close collaboration with inpatient care and primary care.
The facilities have recently been modernised and the department works with modern equipment, including:
Canon CT
Samsung conventional X-ray
Ultrasound

The team consists of radiographers, assistant nurses, a radiologist and a sonographer.
There is also close collaboration with a larger radiology department, giving you the opportunity to occasionally gain experience in an environment with a higher acute patient flow.
About the role
Your main work will be within:
CT
Conventional radiography
Planned and acute examinations

You will work closely with radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and other healthcare professionals.
Working hours are Monday to Friday, 07:30–16:00.
There are no evening or night shifts, no weekend work, no work on public holidays and no on-call duties.
Previous professional experience as a radiographer is an advantage, but not a requirement. Experience in CT and conventional radiography is particularly valuable.
Requirements
We are looking for candidates who:
Hold a radiographer qualification from Finland
Have the legal right to practise as a radiographer in Finland
Are currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
Are interested in working with CT and conventional radiography
Have good communication skills in English
Are motivated to learn Swedish
Are interested in establishing a long-term career and life in Sweden

Meritorious
Previous experience in CT
Previous experience in conventional radiography
Knowledge of Swedish
Swedish professional authorization

The location
The hospital is located in a smaller coastal community in central Sweden, with approximately 24,000 inhabitants in the local area.
The area offers a combination of small-town living and easy access to the sea, lakes, countryside and an extensive archipelago. It is particularly well suited to someone looking for a quieter lifestyle, short distances and good opportunities for outdoor activities and family life.
Schools and childcare are available locally, with good transport connections to larger cities.
Swedish language training and relocation
If you do not already speak Swedish at the required level, Swedish language training is provided and financed as part of the recruitment process.
You begin studying Swedish from Finland through individual online lessons with a private teacher while continuing your current work.
Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.
After relocating, you initially work 50% as a Radiography Assistant while continuing your Swedish studies from 
B2 to C1. During this period, work takes place in the mornings and Swedish studies in the afternoons, Monday to Friday.
Once you have reached the required Swedish level and obtained Swedish professional authorization, you begin working fully as a radiographer.
Salary
During the language completion phase in Sweden, while employed as a Radiography Assistant, 
the salary is: 30,800 SEK/month gross
After obtaining Swedish authorization and starting work as a Radiographer, the starting salary for a candidate without previous professional experience is: 31,100 SEK/month gross
For radiographers with previous professional experience, the salary may be individually determined based on experience and competence.
What Dignus Medical offers you
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during and after your relocation and employment
Assistance with the process of obtaining Swedish professional authorization
Help with relocation and accommodation
Support for your family if needed
Free Swedish language training with a private online tutor

Interested in working as a radiographer in Sweden?
We look forward to hearing from you!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Help Shape the Future of Sustainable Food

At Lantmännen Biorefineries, we develop sustainable ingredients from oats, wheat, and peas that help shape the future of food. As an Application Specialist, you will apply your expertise in ingredient functionality and food systems to develop food applications that demonstrate the full potential of our ingredient portfolio. Combining scientific expertise, creativity, and a hands-on approach, you will turn ideas into practical applications that create value for customers and support business growth. This is a temporary position covering parental leave, with the possibility of extension

This is what you will do

You will be the technical expert connecting our ingredients with real-world food applications.

Your responsibilities include:

Developing and optimizing applications for existing and new food ingredients.
Designing and conducting trials to evaluate product functionality and performance.
Supporting customer projects through technical guidance, demonstrations, and troubleshooting.
Leading application-related projects from concept through prototyping and commercialization.
Evaluating analytical results and translating insights into product recommendations.
Identifying new opportunities through customer feedback, market insights, and emerging food trends.
Collaborating with Sales, Product Development, Production, and Quality teams to deliver successful solutions.
Ensuring compliance with food safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.

This is what you need to succeed

You have:

BSc or MSc in Food Science or Food Technology. We also welcome candidates with substantial hands-on experience in food application development, and deep expertise in ingredient functionality and food systems, especially within the field of dairy and meat analogues.
Experience in application development, product development, technical service, or food ingredient innovation.
Knowledge of food ingredients, functionality, and food processing.
R&D project management capabilities.
Knowledge of GMP, quality systems, and laboratory practices.
Excellent communication skills in English. Swedish is an advantage.

You are:

You combine a strong scientific mindset with practical food application expertise. Whether your expertise has been gained through formal education or hands-on experience, you understand the relationship between food ingredients, processing, structure, texture, and product performance. You can translate this knowledge into food products with the right texture, stability, and eating experience. You are systematic and analytical, while remaining practical and results-oriented in your approach. You use logical thinking and sound judgement to solve problems and drive projects forward efficiently. You are curious and open-minded, yet grounded and pragmatic You balance technical depth with practical execution, delivering results effectively without waiting for every detail to be fully understood

You share our values - Openness, Holistic view, Drive - and our promise of taking responsibility from Field to Fork.

What we offer you

At Lantmännen, sustainability, innovation, and long-term thinking are at the heart of everything we do. We offer an opportunity to work with industry-leading ingredients, contribute to the future of food, and grow within an international group that is continuously investing in innovation and people development.

That is how we make it matter, from field to fork.

Sounds interesting? 

We hope so! You can apply for the position online by attaching your CV or LinkedIn profile. To ensure a more objective and inclusive recruitment process, we ask you to answer a number of screening questions as part of your application instead of submitting a cover letter.

The recruitment process includes assessments and competency-based interviews. For the final candidate, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing will be conducted.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Lantmännen is an agricultural cooperative and Northern Europe’s leader in agriculture, bioenergy and food products. Owned by 17,000 Swedish farmers, Lantmännen has more than 10,000 employees, operations in over 20 countries and an annual turnover of SEK 60 billion. With grain at the heart of the operations, Lantmännen refine arable land resources to make farming thrive. Some of Lantmännen’s best-known food brands are AXA, Kungsörnen, Scan, GoGreen, FINN CRISP, Schulstad and Vaasan. The company is founded on the knowledge and values acquired through generations of farmers. By engaging in research, development and operations throughout the value chain, Lantmännen takes responsibility from field to fork.

Lantmännen Biorefineries is the only large scale producer and supplier of grain-based fuel ethanol in Sweden and is owned by Lantmännen. The company offers attractive, profitable and sustainable protein, ethanol and carbon dioxide products that are produced in a responsible way. The plants are located in Norrköping and Lidköping. Biorefineries has approximately 300 co-workers and an annual turnover of almost SEK 4,5 billion.

More about Lantmännen

Company description:This is the Volvo Group Graduate Program
The 15-month Graduate Program combines 50% time in your home department with 50% dedicated program activities, giving you broad exposure across Volvo Group. Through local and international rotations, short-term assignments, and targeted training in areas such as operations, engineering, and purchasing, you will build a strong understanding of our business, brands and strategy. 
Job description:Your future team 
The ECU Purchasing team buys the Electronic Control Units used in vehicles, powertrains, and gearboxes. The team works with suppliers and internal teams such as engineering, quality, projects, and supply chain to select the right solutions, agree competitive prices, follow supplier performance, support projects, reduce costs, and manage risks such as component shortages or obsolete technology.
 How you’ll contribute  
You will be supporting the development and execution of ECU sourcing strategies, securing competitive cost, quality, delivery, innovation, and supply resilience through effective supplier and stakeholder collaboration.
 Key responsibilities:  
  Help prepare ECU sourcing strategies by collecting information about market trends, new technologies, business needs, and potential suppliers.  
 Support supplier selection by preparing requests for quotation, comparing offers, participating in negotiations, and summarizing recommendations for review.  
 Follow supplier performance in areas such as cost, quality, delivery, innovation, sustainability, and supply continuity, and help coordinate actions when improvements are needed.  
 Assist with purchasing activities during the ECU product lifecycle, including development changes, cost-saving opportunities, contract follow-up, and commercial issue resolution.  
 Help identify purchasing and supply risks, support the preparation of mitigation actions, follow their progress, and raise important issues to the team.  
 Keep purchasing data, contracts, supplier information, sourcing documents, and reports accurately and up to date.
  Who are you? 
We are looking for someone with a strong transformation and collaborative mindset who is eager to learn, explore, and understand the business. You thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new challenges and ambiguity, and take ownership of your own development and growth. With strong analytical skills, you take initiatives and drive tasks forward with determination while bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to the team. 
 You enjoy building relationships and leveraging a global network to create impact while working collaboratively across teams and functions. You also have a passion for Electronics and Business! 
 You meet the following requirements: 
  You have a degree in Master of Technology (M.Tech) or equivalent relevant master’s degree 
 Experience in data analysis, data science, or predictive modelling  
 Project planning and delivery  
 Business requirements analysis and solution design  
 Industrial, logistics, or supply-chain understanding is beneficial  
 Interest in working in global organizations and collaborating across functions, cultures and locations  
  
Experience may come from academic projects, internships, thesis work, or early professional assignments 
 Additional desirable skills:  
  Specialisation in supply chain and electronics engineering  
  
 
 To qualify for the Graduate program, you: 
  Have completed a Master’s degree prior to the start of the program but not more than 3 years ago.  
 Should not have more than three years' full-time relevant working experience in the field prior to starting the program, excluding part-time work during studies.  
 Are fluent in English, both written and verbal.   
 Are willing to travel and participate in international short-term assignments 
  What’s in it for you? 
Our Volvo Group Graduate Program starts in August 2027, and you will be offered a permanent position at FSDV Purchasing department with placement in Sweden, Gothenburg. These are some of the benefits of joining our program: 
  An opportunity to work with the latest technology. 
 An exciting and global working environment with experienced colleagues. 
 Possibility to gain international experience through a short-term assignment abroad. 
 A competitive salary and permanent position from day one. 
 Various workshops and seminars designed to help you grow into your future career at Volvo Group. 
 The possibility to shape your own career with endless career opportunities. 
  
 Read more about the Graduate program here
 The application process 
 The journey begins! An email confirmation will be sent when you submit your application. After this, it is still possible to update your personal profile by logging into your account. The hiring team will review your application together with the hiring manager. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted with information about the following steps.  
 Last day to apply: 22nd of November 2026  
  As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable. 
 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

Are you a proactive, people-focused HR professional eager to drive meaningful change in a dynamic, collaborative environment? Join us at Stoneridge Electronics as an HR Business Partner in Örebro and thrive in a collaborative, innovative culture that empowers you to build a career to be proud of.
We're now looking for a HR Business Partner to be part of the HR team in Sweden and together enable our employees to succeed and to inspire development.
Stoneridge Electronics is a global company and in Sweden we are located in Örebro and Stockholm. In Örebro we have our production and here we are around 300 employees.
 
What you will do as our HR Business Partner
As our HR Business Partner, you’ll play a vital role in supporting our Operations team in Örebro, helping to foster a positive and productive workplace for both employees and managers. You’ll serve as a strategic partner to the local management team, providing HR advisory, driving cooperation with union representatives, and engaging in site forums like the safety committee and site events. With around 300 employees on-site, you’ll be essential in guiding HR strategies and ensuring alignment across our operations organization.
 
You would also;
• Coach and drive the work across the HR cycle and contribute to empowering the managers in the organization as well as colleagues. 
• Establish a trusted partnership with the managers and support them in their leadership to retain, develop and motivate employees in their daily work.  
• Act as a key strategic partner and provide operational support in different ways to the local organization to meet local business objectives and global strategies. 
 
You share Stoneridges core values of teamwork, integrity and social responsibility which means taking responsibility for your own actions, your colleagues and the business.
You will report to the HR Manager in Örebro, who is also based in Örebro, and you will be part of the Swedish HR team, where further HR functions are located in Stockholm. As a member of the Swedish HR team, you will get the opportunity to participate in the development of our HR processes across our Swedish organization as well as lead and/or participate in various HR projects within the Swedish and also for the global HR organization which we are a part of.
 
The skills and experience you need

A university degree in Human Resources Management or equivalent.
A minimum 3-5 years of a relevant working experience.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, experience with the HR system Workday is an added advantage
Experience of working in a production environment would be highly appreciated

What you'll do:
CERN's scientific mission relies on the exchange of knowledge, technologies and equipment across borders. Ensuring that these exchanges meet export-control requirements is essential to managing risks and enabling responsible research.

To support a consistent, proportionate and risk-based approach to export-control compliance, CERN is establishing an internal compliance programme, centred on a new CERN Export Control Compliance Office.

As Export Control Compliance Lead, you will establish and lead the Export Control Compliance Office, developing the governance, policies and processes needed to embed this programme across the Organization.

Working within the Resilience team in OSI-ICS, you will conduct classifications, screenings, due diligence reviews, compliance assessments and export-control evaluations. You will provide expert advice to CERN Management on export-control and related regulatory risks, and work closely with legal, technical and operational experts to ensure effective implementation of export-control requirements.

This is an opportunity to shape a new compliance function at the intersection of science, advanced technology and international regulation.

Your responsibilities:
- Establish and lead CERN's Export Control Compliance Office, developing and implementing the governance framework, policies, processes, guidance, tools and training needed to support a consistent, proportionate and risk-based approach to export-control compliance across the Organization.
- Act as CERN's central focal point for export-control compliance matters, advising personnel, promoting awareness, conducting classifications, screenings, end-user and end-use reviews, compliance assessments, determinations and other due diligence activities, and coordinating inputs as required.
- Support and monitor the operational implementation of export-control requirements and decisions, including the management of export authorisations and associated compliance measures; act as principal adviser and secretariat to the Export Control Compliance Committee and coordinate departmental export-control liaison officers.
- Serve as CERN's contact point on export-control matters with relevant national authorities, external advisers and peer organisations, and maintain an effective external network within the export-control compliance community, particularly in the research sector.
- Maintain authoritative records of export-control compliance assessments, determinations, authorisations, policies, procedures and supporting documentation, including registers of technologies, activities, institutions and persons subject to screening, due diligence or export-control requirements.
- Monitor the effectiveness of CERN's export-control compliance arrangements, identify emerging risks, issues and trends, support the management of incidents, and provide reporting, escalation and recommendations for their continual improvement.
- Carry out such other tasks as may be required to deliver an effective export-control compliance programme.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience working in export controls within regulated sectors such as aerospace, defence, manufacturing, energy, research or higher education.
- Strong knowledge of export-control and dual-use regulatory frameworks; familiarity with one or more of the U.S., EU, Swiss and/or UK export-control regimes is an advantage.
- Demonstrated experience establishing, implementing or maturing compliance programmes, governance arrangements and internal controls.
- Demonstrated experience conducting compliance assessments, due diligence activities, export-control evaluations, export licensing or other regulatory-compliance processes.
- Strong interpersonal and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical, administrative, legal and external stakeholders.
- Strong analytical, drafting and documentation skills, with the ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical guidance, procedures and compliance measures.
- Sound judgement and the ability to assess complex compliance matters, weigh competing considerations and formulate clear, evidence-based recommendations and compliance determinations.
- Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of International Relations, Engineering, Law, Compliance, Economics, Business or a related field. A recognised qualification or certification in export control or compliance would be an advantage.

Your skills:
- Organisational design & development.
- Knowledge management.
- Organisation, planning and control.
- Risk management.
- Archiving and records management.
- Drives work / projects along and sees them through to their conclusion.
- Remains objective, focussed and productive in a stressful environment; focuses on solutions rather than problems.
- Anticipates obstacles; assesses alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.
- Keeps up-to-date with developments in own field of expertise and readily absorbs new information.
- Develops organisational strategy by anticipating future trends and taking a long term view of issues that impact CERN and its environment.
- Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Contract duration (in months): 60
Grade range: 6

What will you do?
As a Mobile Engineering Manager at Rebtel, you will lead the engineers behind our iOS and Android apps, combining hands-on native mobile development with coaching and team leadership. Your daily work will focus on building high-quality mobile experiences, driving technical excellence, and helping engineers grow in their craft. You will also champion the effective use of AI-assisted development to improve productivity while maintaining strong engineering standards and ownership.
This is not a management-only role. You will write and review production code, pair with engineers, and help solve difficult technical problems while taking responsibility for the team's development and delivery. Your impact will come from both what you build and how you help others grow.
Areas of ownership:

Coach and develop engineers through regular one-to-ones, clear feedback and career development. Help people strengthen their technical judgment, grow their skills and take greater ownership.

Stay hands-on with native development. Write and review production code, pair with engineers, and help investigate challenging bugs and performance issues using native platform tools.

Help the team use AI effectively. Lead by example with AI-assisted development tools, share practical approaches and coach engineers to critically evaluate outputs while maintaining code quality, security and ownership.

Drive native app excellence. Set high standards for performance, stability, accessibility and user experience across iOS and Android. Guide technical decisions, architecture, testing and release practices.

Collaborate across teams. Work closely with Product, Design and Backend Engineering to turn customer needs into clear priorities, deliver valuable features and balance short-term goals with long-term app quality.

Build a culture of ownership and accountability. Hire and develop great engineers, set clear expectations and create an environment where people take initiative, solve problems and take pride in what they deliver.

Requirements:

You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. English is our working language, but you'll hear many different languages in our Stockholm office.

A strong track record as a native mobile engineer, with production iOS or Android apps you have personally designed, built and shipped.

Deep hands-on expertise in native iOS development (Swift/Objective-C) or Android development (Kotlin/Java). You understand native architecture, UI, app lifecycle, concurrency, performance and debugging, and are comfortable contributing production code today. You can guide technical decisions across both platforms, although equal expertise in both is not required. Experience limited to React Native or other cross-platform frameworks does not meet this requirement.

Experience leading and developing engineers, including coaching, giving feedback, supporting career growth and managing performance. You know how to stay technically involved without taking over.

Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools. You understand where they add value, where they fall short and how to validate their output.

Strong engineering judgment and the ability to make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing quality, delivery and long-term maintainability.

Why Rebtel?
Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.
This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.
At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:

Pension Plan

Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance

Dental Insurance

Occupational insurance

Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)

Discount on gym memberships

Bonus program

Extra parental pay

30 days annual vacation

Monday breakfasts

Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.

We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Are you ready to make an impact by solving real-world challenges and driving innovation in energy solutions? Join our talented team at Siemens Energy as a Structural Calculation Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the strength, durability, and reliability of our cutting-edge products. You will collaborate with designers daily, contributing to the development of energy solutions that meet the highest industry standards for both onshore and offshore projects. Imagine building and evaluating finite element models to assess static capacity, stiffness, stability, and fatigue of structures while driving efficiency through innovative scripting in Python and MATLAB. Your insights will be delivered through clear technical reports and presentations, making a significant impact on our internal and external stakeholders.
How You’ll Make an Impact
You will analyze and evaluate finite element models to assess the static capacity, stiffness, stability, and fatigue of structures.
Collaborate closely with a team of experienced engineers to develop cost-effective solutions tailored to our customers’ needs.
Create and maintain proprietary scripts in Python and MATLAB to streamline processes and innovate new methods of working.
Deliver clear and impactful results through technical reports and presentations for both internal and external stakeholders.

What You Bring
You possess strong analytical skills and a natural talent for solving technical challenges.
As a team player, you stay organized and focused, ensuring timely and efficient project delivery.
You have experience with the Finite Element Method (FEM) and are skilled in creating simulation models.
Hands-on experience with tools like Abaqus, HyperWorks, Ansa, or Ansys is essential; knowledge of MATLAB and/or Python is a bonus!
You excel in communication and enjoy building strong relationships with both internal teams and customers.
A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related field, with a focus on structural analysis and strength, is required.
You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.

About the Team
You will be part of a team of experienced calculation engineers in a fun and challenging environment, where inclusion and diversity are key pillars. The group is driven by solving challenging problems and staying at the forefront of developing new methods in the field of strength analysis.
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
Application

jobs.description:
BIM Specialist / BIM Manager
OL31 Rail Project, Vagnhärad, Sweden
Shape the future of Swedish infrastructure
HOCHTIEF is one of the world's leading infrastructure and construction groups, employing approximately 38,000 people worldwide. We deliver complex projects across a wide range of sectors, including roads, bridges, tunnels, railways, airports, ports, buildings, and both conventional and renewable energy. With operations across Europe, North America, and the Asia-Pacific region, HOCHTIEF combines engineering expertise with innovative and sustainable solutions to shape the infrastructure of the future.
We are currently looking for an BIM Specialist / BIM Manager to join our team on the OL31 Project in Vagnhärad, Sweden.
The OL31 Project forms part of the Ostlänken programme, one of Sweden's largest and most important railway infrastructure investments. Ostlänken is a new approximately 160-kilometre double-track railway connecting Järna and Linköping, designed to increase capacity, improve regional connectivity and support sustainable transport across Sweden.
The project involves complex civil engineering works, including tunnels, bridges, earthworks and rail infrastructure. Working on OL31 offers the opportunity to contribute to a landmark infrastructure programme while supporting the recruitment and development of a diverse, international project organization.
About the Role
As BIM Specialist / BIM Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating, developing and managing Building Information Modelling (BIM) processes across the project. You will support design, engineering and construction teams by ensuring effective use of digital models, data management systems and BIM workflows throughout the project lifecycle.
The role requires a strong technical background, experience working with infrastructure projects and the ability to manage digital collaboration between designers, engineers, subcontractors and project stakeholders.
 Key Responsibilities
Manage and coordinate BIM processes throughout the project lifecycle.
Develop, maintain and implement BIM Execution Plans (BEPs) and project BIM procedures.
Ensure compliance with client BIM requirements, project specifications and industry standards.
Coordinate multidisciplinary BIM models and perform clash detection.
Manage model federation, review and issue resolution processes.
Support design and construction teams with BIM-related workflows and technical solutions.
Facilitate coordination meetings and manage BIM collaboration between project stakeholders.
Review and validate BIM models for quality, accuracy and constructability.
Manage Common Data Environment (CDE) processes and digital document workflows.
Support the production of 3D, 4D and 5D BIM deliverables.
Coordinate model updates and ensure consistency between design and construction information.
Support as-built model development and project handover requirements.
Train and support project personnel on BIM tools, procedures and best practices.
Monitor BIM performance and recommend continuous improvements.

Requirements
Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, BIM Management, Architecture, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of experience in BIM coordination, BIM management, or digital engineering within construction or infrastructure projects.
Experience working on large infrastructure, railway, tunnel, bridge, or civil engineering projects.
Advanced proficiency in Navisworks, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, and BIM coordination platforms.
Experience with Common Data Environments (CDE), document management systems and digital project delivery.
Strong understanding of BIM standards, model coordination and information management processes.
Experience performing clash detection, model reviews and design coordination.
Experience with ProjectWise, ACC (Autodesk Construction Cloud), BIM 360, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of IFC standards and openBIM workflows.
Experience with 4D planning and construction sequencing.
Familiarity with Swedish infrastructure projects and Trafikverket BIM requirements.
Experience supporting as-built documentation and digital project handover.
Knowledge of construction methodologies and engineering workflows.
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international project teams.

 Language Requirements
Professional working proficiency in English is required.
Swedish is highly meritorious due to the project's regulatory environment, documentation requirements.

 We Offer
The opportunity to work on one of Sweden's largest and most complex infrastructure projects.
An international working environment within a leading global construction company.
Long-term project involvement with significant responsibility and influence.
The chance to contribute to the development of critical rail infrastructure in Sweden.

Location
 Vagnhärad, Sweden 
Apply
If you have the qualifications, experience, and passion for creating a safe and successful construction environment, we would love to hear from you.
Get in touch with Nicole Granlund nicole.granlund@hochtief.se, or apply directly at: https://hochtief.se/karriar/ 
Join HOCHTIEF and help build the infrastructure of tomorrow.

We’re looking for an analytical and business-minded engineer who can connect technical performance with commercial viability and help transform complex engineering analysis into strategic recommendations.

jobs.occupation: Machine Learning Engineer - Medical Image Analysis
jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.
RaySearch is looking for a machine learning engineer with strong experience in medical image analysis to join our ML Imaging team in Stockholm. You will develop deep learning algorithms for medical image analysis in RayStation, our radiotherapy treatment planning system, helping clinical teams deliver effective cancer treatments. RayStation is used at more than 1,000 cancer clinics in more than 50 countries.
About the role
You will develop machine learning models for use in clinical practice, working on medical image segmentation, synthetic CT generation, image registration, and other medical imaging applications.
Working closely with internal clinical specialists and external partner clinics, you will translate clinical needs into methods and models and evaluate their performance. You will also collaborate with regulatory and quality experts to ensure that algorithms are developed, validated, and documented in accordance with applicable medical device requirements.
You will
Develop and evaluate deep learning algorithms for medical imaging using Python and PyTorch.
Prepare and curate clinical imaging datasets, configure and run model training, and maintain reproducible training workflows.
Review relevant research and assess the suitability of methods for clinical applications.
Design experiments and evaluate model performance using appropriate quantitative measures and clinical acceptance criteria.
Collaborate with clinical experts and external clinics on development and validation.
Contribute to the testing and documentation required for medical device software.

Your profile
You have strong experience in medical image analysis. You enjoy investigating problems, testing ideas, and turning promising methods into machine learning models. You take ownership of your work, can plan and carry out development independently, and know when to involve colleagues. You value collaboration, careful evaluation, and clear documentation, and are motivated by improving cancer care.
Requirements
A PhD or master’s degree in computer science, machine learning, engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related field.
At least four years of relevant experience in machine learning or medical image analysis, gained through research or industry, including doctoral research.
Extensive experience developing and evaluating deep learning models for medical image analysis.
A strong understanding of deep learning, computer vision, statistics, and applied mathematics.
Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch.
Familiarity with software engineering practices, including version control, testing, and code reviews.
Excellent spoken and written communication skills in English.

Meriting
Experience with 3D medical imaging, particularly CT, MR, or CBCT.
Experience with one or more of medical image segmentation, image registration, or image synthesis.
Experience developing and validating medical device software or other regulated software.
Experience with tools for experiment tracking, data versioning, and reproducible training workflows.

Our Culture  
At RaySearch, we share a passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our team consists of dedicated experts who strive to deliver exceptional results through collaboration, attention to detail, and cutting-edge technology. We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide.  
Our Offer  
We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Hagastaden, Stockholm’s Life Science Hub. Our modern office space includes an in-house gym, yoga classes, and social activities such as ping pong, table football, and after-work events. We also provide a fantastic lunch buffet, daily fika, and a stunning rooftop terrace with a 360-degree view of Stockholm. This comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.  
Application  
Please apply for the position through the application form below. Selection and interviews will be ongoing. We do not accept applications via e-mail.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Breast and Melanoma Surgeon – University Hospital in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a Specialist in General Surgery with experience and a particular interest in breast and melanoma surgery? 
Are you looking for an opportunity to develop further within specialised cancer surgery while working in a multidisciplinary and academically active environment?
We are currently recruiting a Specialist in General Surgery with experience and a strong professional interest in breast and melanoma surgery for a permanent position at a major university hospital in southwestern Sweden.
The position offers the opportunity to combine specialised clinical work with multidisciplinary cancer care, professional development, teaching and research in a highly specialised hospital environment.
About the position
Your primary focus will be the care and surgical treatment of patients with breast cancer and malignant melanoma.
The role includes both outpatient care and day surgery, and you will be involved in the assessment, treatment and follow-up of patients.
The work is characterised by close multidisciplinary and multiprofessional collaboration, where surgeons work together with other specialists and healthcare professionals throughout the patient's treatment pathway.
Most of the work is carried out during daytime hours. Depending on your individual competence and previous experience, participation in general surgical on-call duties may also be included.
Breast and melanoma surgery
The position is particularly suited to a general surgeon who already has clinical experience within breast surgery, melanoma surgery or related oncological surgery and wishes to continue developing within this field.
You will work with patients with breast cancer and malignant melanoma in a specialised surgical environment that combines clinical care with continuous development.
The broader surgical organisation also includes areas such as upper gastrointestinal surgery, endocrine and sarcoma surgery, as well as acute and trauma surgery.
A university hospital environment
The hospital offers an environment where specialised healthcare, education, clinical development and research are closely connected.
The breast and melanoma surgery field is research-intensive, and teaching and continuous development are natural parts of the position.
For a surgeon who wants to combine clinical expertise with continued academic and professional development, this provides an opportunity to build a long-term career within a large Swedish university hospital.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a Specialist in General Surgery who has a particular interest and relevant experience in breast and melanoma surgery.
You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary setting and are comfortable taking responsibility while contributing to the continued development of the department.
You value close collaboration with colleagues from different professions and specialties and have a patient-centred approach to your work.
Qualifications
We are looking for a candidate who:

Shape the future of enterprise knowledge with Multiply. Design semantic information architectures, develop ontologies and knowledge graphs, and build AI-ready data foundations while contributing to VisFlow Runa, our Knowledge Platform.

About Multiply
Multiply Teknik & IT AB is a Sweden based End-to-End solution Provider specializing in Enterprise Architecture, Data & Information Management, AI, Software Engineering, and Digital Transformation.

We combine specialist knowledge solutions with the development and deployment of our own technology solutions, giving our colleagues the opportunity to work on challenging enterprise initiatives while contributing to innovative products.

We are now looking for experienced Information & Knowledge Architects to join our growing team in Stockholm.

About VisFlow & Runa
VisFlow (visflow.io) is our technology ecosystem focused on connecting enterprise information, processes, knowledge, and operational intelligence.

An important part of VisFlow is Runa, our Knowledge Platform, which focuses on ontology management, knowledge graphs, semantic modelling, metadata, and enterprise information architecture.

Our vision is to be the preferred partner for Flow thinking and End-to-End Operations aspects of any business, semantically enriched knowledge foundations that bring together business concepts, information structures, relationships, and context to support data governance, interoperability, and AI-driven applications.

As part of Multiply, you will have opportunities to contribute to the evolution of Runa and explore how its capabilities can address real enterprise challenges.

The Role
You will work at the intersection of Information Architecture, Data Management, Semantic Technologies, and AI, supporting organizations in developing trusted, connected, and AI-ready information foundations.

Your work will include customer-facing enterprise transformation and architecture assignments, using the technologies, platforms, and approaches best suited to each organization's needs.

Alongside these engagements, you will have opportunities to contribute to VisFlow Runa, bringing practical enterprise experience into our product development and exploring its application where relevant.

Your responsibilities include:

Design and govern enterprise information models, conceptual models, ontologies, and knowledge graphs.

Establish semantic and context layers connecting business concepts, metadata, and technical data structures.

Support enterprise transformation towards AI-ready Data & Information Management.

Develop practical Data Governance frameworks, standards, and information management principles.

Improve Data Quality, Metadata Management, Master Data Management (MDM), and information interoperability.

Apply semantic technologies and knowledge representation approaches to complex enterprise challenges.

Collaborate with business, IT, architecture, and AI teams to implement sustainable information management capabilities.

Contribute expertise and practical insights to the development and application of VisFlow Runa's ontology management and Knowledge Graph capabilities.

Your Profile
We are looking for experienced, pragmatic, and hands-on professionals who combine architectural expertise with an understanding of business needs and enterprise transformation.

Ideally, you have:

7+ years of experience in Information Management, Data Management, Information Architecture, or related fields.

Experience supporting enterprise-wide Data & Information Management initiatives and transformations.

Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, MDM, and Metadata Management.

Experience with enterprise information modelling, ontologies, semantic architecture, or knowledge graphs.

Knowledge of semantic technologies such as RDF, OWL, SHACL, and SPARQL.

Understanding of AI-ready data foundations, knowledge representation, and contextualized information.

Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

A relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree.

Fluent professional English. Swedish is advantageous.

Experience with Knowledge Graph platforms such as GraphDB, Stardog, Neo4j, or Apache Jena, as well as GraphRAG and knowledge-driven AI applications, is considered advantageous.

Why Join Multiply?
Work on challenging enterprise Data & Information Management and AI-readiness initiatives.

Combine customer-facing consulting with opportunities to contribute to our own technology development.

Help shape VisFlow Runa's evolution in ontology management, semantic architecture, and knowledge graphs.

Work with different technologies and architectural approaches across complex enterprise environments.

Collaborate with specialists in Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, Software Development, and AI.

Influence how organizations connect, understand, govern, and utilize enterprise knowledge.

Location & Employment
Location: On-Site, Stockholm Area/Malmö Area

Employment: Permanent, full-time position with Multiply Teknik & IT AB.

Working arrangement: On-Site, Stockholm Area/Malmö Area

Start: As soon as possible. Candidates available immediately or within 1–2 months are particularly welcome.

Join Us
Are you passionate about Information Architecture, Ontologies, Knowledge Graphs, and building AI-ready enterprise information foundations?

Join Multiply, contribute to meaningful enterprise transformation initiatives, and help us advance the future of knowledge management through VisFlow Runa.

TL;DR – We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineering Lead to help scale the future of AI-powered software creation. You'll build and lead the FDE team and partner with our most ambitious customers to turn ideas into real products. This is still a hands-on role: you'll design, write, and ship production code alongside your team, while partnering with our other FDE leaders to shape how the function operates globally. It's a unique opportunity to scale a new discipline from scratch and solve problems that no one has solved before.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.
We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
About the role
Most engineering leadership roles move you away from the code. This one keeps you close to the craft and the customer.
You'll build, develop, and lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers who partner with our customers at the frontier of what Lovable can do, solving hard technical problems across our frontend, backend and AI systems. The goal isn't just to make individual deployments succeed. It's to spot what should become part of the Lovable platform and act on it.
As one of a small group of FDE leaders, you'll set the technical bar for the function and help define how it scales, from its engineering standards and ways of working to how it works with customers and our core product teams.
If you want to build an exceptional engineering team without stepping away from building yourself, this is that role.
What we're looking for
12+ years across software engineering, technical architecture, and customer-facing engineering

Experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams
A track record of remaining deeply hands-on as your leadership scope has grown
Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals, including React and TypeScript on the frontend and robust backend development
Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems
Experience owning complex technical engagements end-to-end
Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users
Ability to move comfortably between writing code, making architectural decisions, leading engineers, and working with senior stakeholders
Comfort operating with high ambiguity, agency, and velocity

Bonus if you've:
Scaled a team or technical function from zero

Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs in production
Led zero-to-one product development
Worked in a founding or early startup environment
Worked across high-growth startups, big tech, consulting, or enterprise AI

What you'll do

Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and hardest technical problems
Design, prototype, and implement solutions alongside your team
Own and guide projects end-to-end, from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager, Parts and Services - Central & Northern Europe / Normet
jobs.description:
Normet is now seeking a Sales Manager to drive parts and services revenue growth and manage key customer relationships across the European mining and tunneling sector. If you are an expert within the mining sector and sales, love to travel and eager to take the next challenge in your career, don't hesitate to apply!
About the role
The Sales Manager serves as the primary point of contact for customers and is responsible for driving parts and services sales and revenue growth by maintaining and expanding existing accounts. As an active account management team member, you need to pay special attention to inventory planning, parts consumption, training, and service requirements at the mine and tunneling site level.
What we offer?
Key role in industry growth: A pivotal position driving Normet’s parts and services expansion across the European mining and tunneling sector.
International environment & dynamic travel: Work with diverse European clients and cross-functional teams, traveling up to 75% to key customer sites in central- and northern Europe.
Impact & ownership: Full accountability for key account planning, TCO modeling, and developing tailored customer solutions.
Collaborative culture: Close synergy with Service, Equipment Sales, and technical support teams across local and international offices.

Work tasks
Key responsibilities involve
Business Growth and Functional
Execution of the sales strategy for parts and services, growth within current and new customer base; responsible for leading and delivering on customer-specific monthly revenue targets.
Active management in customer planning with spare parts, consumption levels, and portfolio offerings available within Normet. Identify gaps in customer purchasing behavior and work to create solutions to penetrate new sales.
Active involvement with recommended spare parts kits and total cost of ownership modeling, pursuit of rental and used equipment opportunities.
Lead on-site review meetings (monthly/quarterly as needed) with regular site visits and interactions.
Address technical inquiries, on-site spare parts management reviews with recommended adjustments, review equipment performance and identify upgrades.
Provide feedback for engineering and production regarding quality, parts reliability, and service with an understanding of bringing forward the voice of the customer.
Active sales opportunity pipeline and customer fleet data management within Normet systems.

Financials
Assist with forecasting, aligned with expected growth and actual order intake.
Responsible for developing and executing the sales plan in a profitable and accountable fashion.
Follow up on accounts receivables of orders as required.

Collaboration and Customer Relations
Proactive customer focus to positively support the growth of Normet.
Work alongside with Service Manager and Service teams to manage regional accounts.
Coordinate with the local / international Normet order processing and technical teams.
Collaborate closely with the Equipment Sales team throughout the sales process to identify future capital and after-sales opportunities.
Develop and collect market knowledge. Identify and review the competition and relay this information to the Normet Sales and Service Teams.

We are looking for
A minimum of 5 years’ experience in mining and aftermarket sales support. Account Management experience is considered an advantage.
Excellence in written and verbal communication in English. Other Central and/or Northern European languages are seen as benefit.
Willingness to travel up to 75% of working time within Europe.
Experience with MS Office Suite, CRM systems, and sales analytics tools.
Budget/forecasting skills.
Capacity to operate in a demanding environment with competing priorities.
Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
An elevated level of responsiveness, organization, and interpersonal skills.
Detail orientation, financial acumen and a strong command of sales tools and account management.

Other Information
Permanent and fulltime position.
Travel up to 75% of working time within Europe. Your home office could be in Sweden, Norway or Austria.
Start: as soos as possible.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Myntro is a company in the middle of a transformation, shifting toward a more product- and technology-driven, data-enabled business. We are looking for a System Developer who wants to join that journey and help build our future. Are you a curious builder who enjoys creating new systems, navigating complexity, and using modern technology to solve real business problems? Then keep reading!
About The Role
As a System Developer at Myntro, you'll join our DevOps team with end-to-end ownership of applications and systems at the heart of our debt portfolio investment business. Working closely with our investment team, you'll help turn complex portfolio data into reliable systems that support valuation, purchasing decisions, and portfolio management.
Our current focus is building a new investment platform and the services around it. You'll have real opportunities to design and build new capabilities, while also improving and maintaining the existing systems that keep the business running. You'll contribute across the development lifecycle and help shape technical decisions with both immediate and long-term impact.
In this role, you will:

Design, build, and maintain systems, services, and integrations for our debt portfolio investment business.

Develop a new investment platform that supports portfolio valuation, purchasing, and management.

Take ownership from design and implementation through deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.

Build with C#/.NET, SQL, Azure services, and microservice and event-driven architectures.

Improve and simplify existing applications and data flows in a complex technical landscape.

Contribute to architecture, Azure infrastructure, code quality, testing, observability, and how we build.

Who You Are
We are looking for someone who is curious, self-driven, and likes real engineering work. You enjoy understanding both the business problem and how systems actually behave, finding weak points, and making them better. You're comfortable exploring unfamiliar areas and learning what you need to move the work forward.
You take ownership, care about quality, and like building things that hold up in production. You're pragmatic and collaborative, but you don't wait for someone else to define every step. You can move between new development, architecture, infrastructure, data, and existing applications based on what the problem requires.
AI-assisted development isn't new to you; it's already part of how you work. You have your own setup, your own opinions, and you're paying attention to where the craft is heading. That matters here. We're actively building AI into both how we develop and what we deliver, and we need people who are already leaning in, not catching up.
We see that you likely have:

A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

Minimum 5 years of software development experience, ideally in production-critical environments.

Strong .NET/C# development skills.

Solid understanding of SQL, data modelling, and data flows.

Hands-on experience with Azure, cloud infrastructure, and microservice architectures.

Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Experience in investment systems, finance, or debt portfolios is not required. What matters is that you're interested in learning the business context and applying your engineering skills to it.
Why join Myntro?
At Myntro, you'll work in a small team with broad ownership and close access to the people who use what you build. The new investment platform is important to how we value, purchase, and manage debt portfolios, and there is still plenty to design, build, and shape.
This is a good place if you are looking for variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to combine software development with architecture, cloud infrastructure, data, and real business problems. You'll be part of a team that's expected to think, build, operate, and improve together.
Our culture is built on care, accountability, and the belief that the best results come from working together. Collaboration, customer focus, personal accountability, and simplicity are how we actually make decisions, not just words on a wall.
Interested? Welcome to apply!
Sounds like your next challenge? We review applications and interview on a rolling basis, so don't wait too long to apply. The role is full-time and based at our head office in central Gothenburg.
For questions regarding the role or recruitment process, please contact Lema Naderi, our Talent Acquisition Specialist – lema.naderi@myntro.com 
We look forward to receiving your application!
